parameters.jsCode:
// Pantry Inventory Matrix
// Edit this list to reflect what is actually in your pantry / fridge.
const pantryItems = [
  { name: 'Chicken breast', category: 'Fridge', quantity: '1 pack' },
  { name: 'Bio ham', category: 'Fridge', quantity: '1 pack' },
  { name: 'Canned chickpeas', category: 'Canned', quantity: '1 can' },
  { name: 'Mozzarella', category: 'Fridge', quantity: '4 packs' },
  { name: 'Por pizza dough', category: 'Fridge', quantity: '2 rolls' },
  { name: 'Toast bread', category: 'Bread', quantity: '1 loaf' },
  { name: 'Croissants', category: 'Bread', quantity: '2' },
  { name: 'Knusperbrot crackers', category: 'Bread', quantity: '1 pack' },
  { name: 'Cream cheese', category: 'Fridge', quantity: '1 tub' },
  { name: 'Cheese blocks', category: 'Fridge', quantity: '1 block' },
  { name: 'Cheese slices', category: 'Fridge', quantity: '1 pack' },
  { name: 'Cheese sticks', category: 'Fridge', quantity: '1 pack' },
  { name: 'Greek Yogurt', category: 'Fridge', quantity: '1 tub' },
  { name: 'Yogurt', category: 'Fridge', quantity: '1 pot' },
  { name: 'Bio Milk', category: 'Fridge', quantity: '1 bottle' },
  { name: 'Salad Leaves', category: 'Vegetables', quantity: '1 bag' },
  { name: 'Broccoli', category: 'Vegetables', quantity: '1 head' },
  { name: 'Cucumber', category: 'Vegetables', quantity: '1' },
  { name: 'Blueberries', category: 'Fruit', quantity: '1 box' },
  { name: 'Grapes', category: 'Fruit', quantity: '1 bunch' },
  { name: 'Cherries', category: 'Fruit', quantity: '1 box' },
  { name: 'Bananas', category: 'Fruit', quantity: '1 bunch' },
  { name: 'Apples', category: 'Fruit', quantity: 'several' },
];

const inventoryText = pantryItems
  .map((i) => '- ' + i.name + ' (' + i.category + ', ' + i.quantity + ')')
  .join('\n');

return [
  {
    json: {
      inventoryText,
      itemCount: pantryItems.length,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    },
  },
];

options.systemMessage: You are Chef Léon, a friendly French household chef. Choose ONE simple dinner recipe that can be cooked in under 20 minutes using ONLY the pantry ingredients provided by the user. Do not invent ingredients that are not in the pantry. Reply with: the recipe name, total prep+cook time, an ingredient list taken from the pantry, and 4-6 short numbered cooking steps. Keep the tone warm and family-friendly, in English.
